column1: # ontology-grandfather-allowlist.tsv — the SHRINK-ONLY ratchet of `fnd:`
# label / plan-sentinel tokens that were already in the tracked tree when
# ontology-registry.tsv was adopted and that the registry deliberately does
# NOT list (ADR 0032, epic temperloop#1910 L0-b). Enforced by
# workflows/scripts/config/check-ontology-registry.sh, whose ratchet is the
# same shape as exec-bit-grandfather-allowlist.tsv's: a token present here
# but absent at the ratchet base ref (origin/main) is ALLOWLIST-GREW and
# fails the gate; a token removed is a legal shrink.
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. A NEW label or sentinel goes in the registry, never
# here — this file is not a second vocabulary, it is visible, payable debt.
# When a listed token disappears from the tree (the fixture is cleaned up,
# the prose reworded), DELETE its line in the SAME PR — the gate fails
# GRANDFATHER-STALE on a listed token the tree no longer contains, and on a
# listed token the registry now lists (the debt was paid by promotion).
# FORMAT — TAB-separated, two columns:
#   1. TOKEN    the exact token the checker's scan yields — a `fnd:` label
#               (`fnd:<field>:<value>`) or a sentinel (`[<c>]`)
#   2. REASON   mandatory, non-empty: where it lives and why it is not
#               vocabulary (name the tracking issue if one exists)
fnd:status:done
